QuestInfo.0: You have defeated Xerxes, but his underlings are still running amok. Eliminate the rest so the Chief can get his tailgate going.
QuestInfo.1: Take out the rest of the monsters so the townsfolk (who are still nowhere to be seen!) can enjoy game day.
QuestInfo.2: The monsters are gone...for now. If there's one constant in Maple World, it's that they always come back.
QuestInfo.name: Game Day Detail

0.0: Hey, sport. Thanks for cleaning up the Coliseum. Game day is almost here!
0.1: Xerxes is out on his butt, but some of his critters are still running around. I've got my hands full with the office betting pool, so can you round up the last of them for me?

yes.0: Man, you are a real go-getter, you know that? I'd love to keep you around to help with the championship.
yes.1: Alright look, the golden critters are refusing to get lost. That means Golden Rabbits, Golden Ferrets, Golden Scorpies, and Golden Mammoths all need to go. 100 ought to teach them. Oh, and I'll even pay you this time!

no.0: Well...darn it. Guess I'll just have a few wings.

1.0: Now we're talking. And I'm all set with the pit barbecue and potato salad.

yes.0: They're gone for now, but I bet the smell of barbecue will bring them back. Check in sometime, 'cause I might have more work for you. For now, take it easy.

mob.0: Those things are so noisy! I can't concentrate on filling out my brackets. Remember, take out 100 of each of the golden things.
